---
title: "About"
---

The WHOI CMIP data server is a shared store of CMIP6 model output and
reanalysis products for WHOI researchers, mainly in the Physical Oceanography
Department. It replaces the older CMIP6 Community Storage Server
({{< old-site >}}), which stays online until this site is ready.

## Layout

Files live on WHOI's VAST storage under `{{< var vast_prefix >}}`. CMIP6
output uses the CMIP Data Reference Syntax (DRS) directory layout:

```
{{< var vast_prefix >}}/
  cmip6/<activity_id>/<institution_id>/<source_id>/<experiment_id>/<member_id>/<table_id>/<variable_id>/<grid_label>/<version>/
  cmip7/...                      reserved, same scheme
  reanalysis/20crv3/...          e.g. reanalysis/20crv3/Monthlies/2mSI-MO/air.2m.mon.mean.nc
  era5/reanalysis/...            ERA5
  ocean_reanalysis/<product>/... GLORYS12V1, SODA3.12.2, and others
  cmems/..., prism/...           other products
```

Non-CMIP6 products keep their provider's own file names and directory layout,
so files match the product's documentation. The [catalog](catalog.qmd) gives
every catalogued product the same facets: `product`, `frequency`, `level`,
`variable_id`, `version`. [Holdings](holdings.qmd) lists every product with
its path.

For example:

```
{{< var vast_prefix >}}/cmip6/CMIP/NCAR/CESM2/historical/r1i1p1f1/Amon/tas/gn/1/
    tas_Amon_CESM2_historical_r1i1p1f1_gn_185001-201412.nc
```

Each directory level is one facet (see the
[CMIP6 DRS documentation](https://wcrp-cmip.github.io/WGCM_Infrastructure_Panel/Papers/CMIP6_global_attributes_filenames_CVs_v6.2.7.pdf)).
Version directories here are numbered (`1`, `2`), not the ESGF
`vYYYYMMDD` dates.
The [catalog](catalog.qmd) indexes every catalogued file with these facets, and the
[browser](browse.qmd) searches a dataset-level summary of it.
